```{r}
#listar los archivos
#ubicación de los archivos 
path <- "D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/all_ciriquant_files/"
list.files(path)
ciriq_files <- sort(list.files(path,pattern= "ciriquant" ,full.names=TRUE))

ciriq_files_list <- list()

#poner los archivos en una lista
for (i in 1:length(ciriq_files)){
  bsjbgi <- read.csv( as.character(ciriq_files[i]) , sep= "\t", header = TRUE)
  ciriq_files_list[[as.character(basename(ciriq_files[i]))]] <- bsjbgi
}
```

```{r}

path <- "D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/"

tabla_readnum2 <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(ciriq_files)){
  tabla<-as.data.frame((ciriq_files_list[[i]]$circRNA_ID))
  tabla[,2]<-as.data.frame((ciriq_files_list[[i]]$X.junction_reads))
  tabla[,3]<-(basename(names(ciriq_files_list[i])))
  tabla[,4] <- as.data.frame((ciriq_files_list[[i]]$external_gene_name))
  tabla_readnum2<-rbind(tabla,tabla_readnum2)
}


# reordena la tabla
tabla_readnum_4 <-tabla_readnum2[,c(3,1,2,4)]
#renombra las columnas de la tabla 
colnames(tabla_readnum_4) <- c("sample","circRNA_ID","readNumber","geneName")

tabla_readnum_5 <- tabla_readnum_4[,c(2,4)]
tabla_readnum_6 <- tabla_readnum_5[!duplicated(tabla_readnum_5$circRNA_ID),]

tabla_readnum_7 <- tabla_readnum_6[,1]

write.table(tabla_readnum_6,paste0(path,"ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/circRNA_ID_ciri_geneName.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)

write.table(tabla_readnum_7,paste0(path,"ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/circRNA_ID_ciri.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)


tabla_readnum2 <-tabla_readnum2[,c(3,1,2)]
tabla_readnum2[,1] <- (tabla_readnum2[,1])
tabla_readnum2 <- tabla_readnum2[order(tabla_readnum2[,1]),]
#renombra las columnas de la tabla 
colnames(tabla_readnum2) <- c("sample","circRNA_ID","readNumber")

df <- tabla_readnum2 
df <- df[df$readNumber > 2,]

#CIRI_circs<- unique(as.character(df[,2]))
#length(unique(as.character(df[,2])))

df <- df[,c(2,3,1)]
repeted<-df[duplicated(df[,c('circRNA_ID',"sample")]),]
df<-df[!duplicated(df[,c('circRNA_ID',"sample","readNumber")]),]

df_wide <- reshape(df, idvar = "circRNA_ID", timevar = "sample", direction = "wide")
df_wide[is.na(df_wide)] <- 0

df_wide2 <- df_wide[,-1]
rownames(df_wide2) <- df_wide[,1]
df_wide2<-df_wide2+1

# Ordenar las muestras por condición
colnames(df_wide2) <- c("c24_1","c24_2","c24_3","c24_4","c6_1","c6_2","c6_3","c6_4","n24_1","n24_2","n24_3","n24_4","n6_1","n6_2","n6_3","n6_4")

cm_6_c_n <- df_wide2[,c(5,6,7,8,13,14,15,16)]
cm_24_c_n <- df_wide2[,c(1,2,3,4,9,10,11,12)]

dir.create(paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results"))
write.table(df_wide2,paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/count_matrix_ciri.txt"), sep="\t", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Assign condition (affected versus unaffected), you can assign any name, just keep the number of conditions
stimulus <- factor(rep(c("c6","n6"), each = 4))
# set a datframe with factors
batch = factor(c("Batch1", "Batch2", "Batch3", "Batch4", "Batch1", "Batch2", "Batch3", "Batch4"))

# Crear coldata con condición y batch
coldata = data.frame(row.names = colnames(cm_6_c_n), stimulus, batch)
coldata

#devtools::install_github("zhangyuqing/sva-devel")
library(sva)
combat_counts <- ComBat_seq(counts = as.matrix(cm_6_c_n), batch = coldata$batch, group = stimulus)

```


```{r}
library(DESeq2)

stimulus <- factor(rep(c("c6","n6"), each = 4))
# set a datframe with factors
targets <- data.frame(stimulus)

dds=DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(combat_counts,coldata,design=~stimulus)

# Look the factors and columns
colData(dds)[1:8,]
dds$stimulus = relevel(dds$stimulus, "c6")

dds <- DESeq(dds) 
resultsNames(dds)

#Get_Normalized_counts
dds2 <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds2_norm<- counts(dds2, normalized=TRUE)
dds2_norm<-as.data.frame(dds2_norm)
setDT(dds2_norm, keep.rownames = TRUE)[]
write.table(dds2_norm,paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/normalized_deseq2_count_matrix_ciri_c6.txt"), sep="\t", quote = FALSE,row.names = F)

Res1 = results(dds, contrast=c("stimulus","n6","c6"))
Res2 <- as.data.frame(Res1)
Res2<-na.omit(Res2)
setDT(Res2, keep.rownames = TRUE)[]

library(dplyr)
Res3 <- mutate(Res2 ,Regulation = 
                 ifelse(Res2$pvalue < 0.05 & Res2$log2FoldChange > 1,"Up",
                        ifelse(Res2$pvalue < 0.05 & Res2$log2FoldChange < -1,"Down","Unchanged"
                        )))

library(ggplot2)
Grafico1 <-ggplot(Res3, aes(x= log2FoldChange, 
                            y= -log10(pvalue), 
                            colour=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2) +
  xlab(paste("log2(FoldChange)")) +
  ylab("-log10(pval)") +
  xlim(c(-5, 5)) + 
  ylim(c(0, 5)) +
      ggtitle("NE_stimulus_6")+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up"= "red","Down"="blue","Unchanged"="darkgray"))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  labs(fill = "Regulation")+
  theme_bw()

print(Grafico1)

cm_6_c_n_DE <- Res3
tabla_readnum_8 <- tabla_readnum_4[,c(2,4)]
tabla_readnum_8 <- tabla_readnum_8[!duplicated(tabla_readnum_8$circRNA_ID),]

cm_6_c_n_DE_ann <- merge(cm_6_c_n_DE,tabla_readnum_8,by.x="rn", by.y="circRNA_ID",all.x=T)
cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2 <- cm_6_c_n_DE_ann[order(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann$log2FoldChange, decreasing = T),]
cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3 <- cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2[cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2$Regulation!="Unchanged",]

cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3_top <- cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3 %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n=10)
cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3_top$circname <- paste0(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3_top$rn," | ",cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3_top$geneName)


Grafico2 <-ggplot(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann, aes(x= log2FoldChange, 
                            y= -log10(pvalue), 
                            colour=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2) +
  geom_label_repel(data = cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3_top, aes(label = cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3_top$circname), max.overlaps = Inf, size=2,force = 15, box.padding = 0.5) +#+
  xlab(paste("log2(FoldChange)")) +
  ylab("-log10(pval)") +
  xlim(c(-5, 5)) + 
  ylim(c(0, 5)) +
  ggtitle("NE_stimulus_6")+

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up"= "red","Down"="blue","Unchanged"="darkgray"))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  labs(fill = "Regulation")+
  theme_bw()

print(Grafico2)

cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_4<- as.data.frame(table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3$Regulation))


#Save_table
write.table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2,paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_DE_ann.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)
write.table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3,paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_only_DE_ann.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)
write.table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_4,paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_only_DE_ann_numbers.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)

#Save Volcano
cairo_pdf(paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/Volcano_c6_n6.pdf"),width = 6,height = 6)
print(Grafico1)
dev.off()

cairo_pdf(paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/Volcano_c6_n6_labeled.pdf"),width = 6,height = 6)
print(Grafico2)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
cq_24<- read.table("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/24_c_n_DE_ann.txt",header = T,sep = "\t")


cq_24_2 <- cq_24 %>% arrange(pvalue) %>% slice_head(n=10)
cq_24_2$circname <- paste0(cq_24_2$rn," | ",cq_24_2$geneName)


Grafico2 <-ggplot(cq_24, aes(x= log2FoldChange, 
                            y= -log10(pvalue), 
                            colour=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, size=1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = cq_24_2, 
                   aes(label = cq_24_2$circname), 
                   max.overlaps = Inf, 
                   size=3,
                   force = 100, 
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   color="black",
                   #xlim=c(-5,5), 
                   #ylim=c(4,7.5),
                   force_pull = 5)+#+
  xlab(paste("log2 FoldChange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = log2(2), linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("-log10 pvalue ") +
  xlim(c(-5, 5)) + 
  ylim(c(0,7.5 )) +
  ggtitle("")+

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up"= "red","Down"="blue","Unchanged"="darkgray"))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  labs(fill = "Regulation")+
  theme_classic()

print(Grafico2)
library(Cairo)

cairo_pdf(paste0("D:/45_circRNAs_seba/02_ciriquant/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/Volcano_c24_n24_labeled_new.pdf"),width = 7,height = 6)
print(Grafico2)
dev.off()
```
